comparison.objective: Candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs; record turns a drum on its side and rolls it into an angled bay.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires millimetre-scale coaxial impact and fragment recovery; record requires bimanual opposed-end forces to steer a rolling drum rather than slide it.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires clean fractures, insert retention, fragment containment, and two-second stability; record requires the drum against the bay’s back bar, released, with a one-second hold, while sliding caps the score.
comparison.reason: Whole-body rolling and steering of a large object differ fundamentally from local impact fracture.
